title: IngestAck — 200 response of POST /v1/stores/{store_id}/operation-batches
description: Frozen field order: batch_id, status, accepted_through_seq, ingested_count, duplicate_count, head_entry_hash, next_expected_seq, cloud_cursor. The Hub clears its durable outbox only when accepted_through_seq equals the last entry's operation_seq and head_entry_hash equals the last entry's entry_hash.

cloud_cursor.description: "{store_id in 32-hex N form}:{accepted_through_seq}" when new entries were appended, else null. Change-feed use only.
